name: Soul Link
tooltip:
Soul Link
Talent
16% of base mana100 yd range
Instant
Requires Warlock
When active, 20% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, Felhunter, Felguard, or subjugated demon instead.  That damage cannot be prevented.  In addition, both the demon and master will inflict 5% more damage.  Lasts as long as the demon is active and controlled.
